title: shopping
content:
Feature: Shopping Cart – Add Product ($10.90) and Validate Cart

Page URL: https://react-shopping-cart-67954.firebaseapp.com/

Login Flow:

No login required.

Navigate directly to https://react-shopping-cart-67954.firebaseapp.com/

Acceptance Criteria:

AC1. Product Listing

- The page displays a list of products with:

- Product image

- Product name

- Price

- "Add to cart" button

- A shopping cart icon is visible on the right side.

- Cart is empty on initial page load.

AC2. Add Product to Cart

- Locate the product with price "$10.90".

- Click the "Add to cart" button.

- The cart drawer opens automatically.

- The selected product is displayed in the cart.

- Product name, quantity (1), and price ($10.90) are visible.

- Cart subtotal updates to "$10.90".

AC3. Product Validation

- Search visually for the product priced "$10.90".

- Clicking "Add to cart" adds only the selected product.

- Cart contains exactly one product.

- Product price in cart matches "$10.90".

- Quantity defaults to 1.

- Subtotal equals "$10.90".

AC4. Cart Persistence

- Cart badge updates to show "1".

- Checkout button remains enabled.

- Product remains in the cart until manually removed.

User Flows:

Flow 1 — View Products

1. User navigates to https://react-shopping-cart-67954.firebaseapp.com/

2. Product catalog loads successfully.

3. Product priced "$10.90" is visible.

Flow 2 — Add Product

1. User locates the product with price "$10.90".

2. User clicks "Add to cart".

3. Cart drawer opens.

4. Product appears in the cart.

5. Quantity = 1.

6. Price = "$10.90".

7. Subtotal = "$10.90".

Flow 3 — Validate Cart

1. User reviews the cart.

2. Verify:

- Correct product name

- Price = "$10.90"

- Quantity = 1

- Subtotal = "$10.90"

3. Checkout button is visible and enabled.
